title: Camel Ibaraki-style dialect pass
rationale: A playthrough note reported that the camel in the Israel/Nazareth chapter speaks with Ibaraki-style rural dialect. The English localization should preserve this as light rustic country speech, not as a heavy regional caricature.

records.speaker: Camel
records.current: Camel: What do you want?{CTRL:1}Me: May I eat the hay?{CTRL:0}Camel: Eat all you like.
records.replacement: Camel: Whaddya want?{CTRL:1}Me: May I eat the hay?{CTRL:0}Camel: Eat your fill.
records.notes: Adds light rural informality through 'Whaddya' and the idiom 'Eat your fill' while preserving the player's standard phrasing.
